references.text: The previous verse describes the pastureland extending a thousand cubits from the city wall, and this verse further elaborates on the measurements.
Joshua describes the Levitical cities with their surrounding pasturelands, fulfilling the instructions given in Numbers regarding the cities and territories of the Levites.
Ezekiel's vision of the future land includes detailed measurements for the city's areas and pasturelands, reflecting the principles of land allocation found in Numbers.
1 Chronicles mentions the Levitical cities with their pasturelands that were given to the descendants of Aaron, in accordance with the regulations in Numbers.
Leviticus refers to the pastureland around the Levitical cities that cannot be sold, linking it to the provisions concerning the territories of the Levites.
